name: Hyakka Ryouran
source:
Hero was about to live the last months before graduation peacefully when he was forced to transfer to all-girls school where his father was a chairman. What will happen to the only male student in all-girl school?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公原本打算平静度过毕业前的最后几个月，却被迫转学到父亲担任理事长的女子学校。作为全校唯一的男学生，他将迎来怎样的校园生活？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
